title: Customer requirements coverage audit
finding: All source rows are captured and mapped in this audit. The previous plan covered broad areas but did not explicitly specify every detail. This is not implementation or acceptance evidence.

scope.source_text: This template is designed to become a repeatable project-management checklist for a South Florida residential construction project.
scope.planned_requirement: Reusable residential project template; project-specific scope and location configuration.

scope.source_text: It begins when approved/stamped plans are received and continues through bidding, procurement, construction, required inspections, closeout, and issuance of Certificate of Occupancy or Certificate of Completion.
scope.planned_requirement: Retain the full approved-plans-to-CO/CC lifecycle. The small demo is a subset, not the full product scope.

scope.source_text: Municipal requirements vary by jurisdiction and permit scope, so inspection names should be verified against the permit card and local building department for each project.
scope.planned_requirement: Project setup must record jurisdiction, permit scope, inspection names/codes, applicability and confirmation. Do not treat the template as a universal inspection list.

inspection_notes.source_text: Miami-Dade County notes that inspections are required before covering or concealing work, and that approved/stamped plans plus the permit card must be on site.
inspection_notes.planned_requirement: Explicit before-cover inspection gates and site-document readiness. Preserve the customer note; confirm applicability per project.

inspection_notes.source_text: Required inspections can include Building, Electrical, Mechanical, Plumbing, Zoning, Fire, windows/shutters, landscaping, and other permit-specific inspections.
inspection_notes.planned_requirement: Allow named and additional permit-specific checks, including shutters where applicable. Do not limit inspection types to the demo.

inspection_notes.source_text: A Certificate of Occupancy or Certificate of Completion validates that the project has been completed in compliance with applicable code.
inspection_notes.planned_requirement: Store certificate type and issued-document evidence; a completed task or AI statement is not certificate issuance.

inspection_notes.source_text: CO/CC issuance requires approved inspections and completion holds to be cleared.
inspection_notes.planned_requirement: Track inspection approvals and hold clearance separately from application submission and certificate receipt.

remaining_design_details.required_detail: Preserve Waiting / Working / Blocked / Done and High / Medium / Low. Specify how readiness and review states relate to those statuses. Provide Due + overdue / overdue only / off. Do not collapse Waiting and Blocked without a defined mapping.

Preserve all 13 trade-specific bid follow-ups, labor/material splits, scope gaps, exclusions, shop drawings, product approvals/NOAs, value engineering requests, comparison, recommendation, and signed scope/schedule/delay/payment terms.

Keep the original baseline separate from revised forecasts and actual dates. Turn clear before/after rules into explicit dependencies. Confirm ambiguous timing, working calendars and durations; do not manufacture dates from broad labels.
Preserve current approved plan sets, permit/inspection codes, visible address, site documents, kickoff safety/sequence, temporary water/power/sanitation, survey and erosion controls.
Track long-lead items, supplier timing, engineering packages, sizes, product approvals, opening readiness, shop drawings, field measurements and cabinet/stone/appliance coordination.

remaining_design_details.source_ids: All 35 P6 rows; inspection rows/notes on P2 to P4
remaining_design_details.required_detail: Add named checks and conditional gas, termite documentation, waterproofing/flashing, pool stages, fire, elevator, right-of-way and other permit checks. Record applicability; distinguish document checks, official inspections, tests and certificate issuance.

The simplified mockup only showed plumbing approval. Preserve applicable mechanical/plumbing/electrical rough approvals, then insulation installation and approval before drywall. Included low-voltage/security rough work also precedes drywall; its source row does not specify an inspection. Preserve the screw/nail inspection before finishing when required.
Room-by-room punch walk, same-day assignment with owner/date/priority, daily correction tracking, final cleaning after punch, and owner acceptance after cleaning.

Separate trade and manufacturer warranties; retain product approvals/NOAs, as-built survey, final inspection approvals and permit closure. Handoff binder must include manuals, contacts, warranties and colors.
Track fees, failed inspections and missing-document holds; record clearance; distinguish application from certificate receipt and preserve the issued document.
Include reconciliation of invoices, retainage and change orders after CO, and lessons learned after turnover. Deferring a full accounting system must not remove these customer requirements.

Tile Due Timing is Wet areas/floors, which is not a date rule. Pool entry bundles multiple stages. Some inspection rows overlap master tasks and differ in qualifiers. Resolve per project with linked records, preserving every original source reference.
